title: Empirical radius R_emp of the parity-odd coset spectrum
analysis: R_emp exceeds the variance-1 semicircle radius 2 by 0.07-0.19, but the per-q standard deviation (0.05-0.12) is comparable to the excess: the max-statistic is noisy at these sample sizes (8-9 q per design). No clean K- or m-scaling resolved. The bulk Stieltjes convergence (m^-1.2) is unaffected — it excludes the edge.
status: [MEASURED, noisy]; needs ~100 q per design for a conclusion

resolution.conclusion: the earlier 'excess over 2' was upward noise of the max statistic on 8-9 q samples; the full q-curve gives mean 1.95 < 2 (finite-m semicircle approaches 2 from below) with rare outliers to 2.77. NO K-structure in the radius. The variance-1 semicircle is the correct limiting reference.
